title: D&T Risk Oversight Analyst
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Cyber Security Risk Management Analyst is responsible for conducting comprehensive cybersecurity risk assessments and providing guidance for management of risks. This role involves evaluating the likelihood and impact of threat actors compromising cybersecurity vulnerabilities and assessing the effectiveness of new controls to reduce risk. The analyst will be capable of producing cyber risk reports tailored to both technical and non\-technical audiences, as well as managing actions and findings.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative cybersecurity risk assessments to evaluate the likelihood and impact of potential threats.
* Perform quantitative risk assessments to measure the reduction of risk associated with the implementation of new controls.
* Develop and deliver cyber risk reports and recommendations for senior leaders, based on data\-driven risk analysis.
* Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Manage actions and findings from risk assessments to ensure timely resolution and mitigation
* To ensure threats are treated in accordance with company risk tolerance thresholds and endorsed with appropriate authority.
* Proven experience in conducting cybersecurity risk assessments and developing risk mitigation strategies.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity risk methodologies and best practice for qualitative and quantitative risk management and the ability to perform relative risk assessments.


***Why you?***
**Basic Qualifications:**
* 8 – 14 years of relevant experience
* Proven experience in conducting cybersecurity risk assessments and developing risk mitigation strategies.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity risk methodologies and best practice for qualitative and quantitative risk management and the ability to perform relative risk assessments.
* Familiarity with the healthcare, pharma, and manufacturing industries is highly desirable.
* Able to assist in accessing and managing risks and have a strong understanding of risk management principles, regulatory compliance, and security frameworks.
* Knowledge of cyber threats and vulnerabilities, and countermeasures that can be applied to identified cybersecurity risks.
* Performing risk assessments, generating reports and managing risks and actions.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Degree or higher
* Excellent management skills to effectively balance unexpected and conflicting priorities as they arise
* Experience operating effectively across matrixed organizations
* Operate across geographies and across business lines.
* Intercultural sensitivity
* Ability to effectively manage conflicting priorities in alignment with overall business and departmental strategies.
* Developing strong relationships with leaders of complementary programs (e.g. Procurement, Legal, Ethics \& Compliance) to ensure harmonization.
* Certification in Risk \& Information Systems Control (CRISC)
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-09\-30
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior IT Security Analyst
description:
About the Role:
   

  

 As a Senior IT Security Analyst, you will engage in advanced cybersecurity tasks with a high level of autonomy. Your contributions will be crucial for maintaining a secure IT environment and anticipating potential threats. You'll exercise thorough security measures and guide less experienced team members.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support vulnerability management activities across cloud, infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, and application environments.
* Review and analyze findings from security tools such as CSPM, vulnerability scanners, container security tools, and application security platforms.
* Work with infrastructure, cloud, application, and DevOps teams to drive remediation of identified security issues.
* Support cloud security posture management across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Manage EDR and XDR platforms: Deploy, configure, and optimize security tools to monitor endpoints, integrate cross\-layered telemetry (cloud, network, and email), and eliminate security silos.
* Detect and respond to threats: Analyze advanced multi\-vector alerts, hunt for hidden attackers, and orchestrate automated playbooks to rapidly isolate compromised systems and minimize response times.
* Review cloud misconfigurations, exposed resources, identity risks, network security gaps, and compliance issues.
* Assist in container and Kubernetes security reviews, including image vulnerabilities, runtime exposure, cluster configuration, and workload security.
* Support vulnerability prioritization based on severity, exploitability, exposure, asset criticality, and business impact.
* Help maintain dashboards, reports, trackers, and metrics for vulnerability remediation and security posture.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive security tasks, reporting, data enrichment, and remediation workflows.
* Support basic application security and shift\-left activities, including SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency risks, and secure development awareness.
* Assist with basic forensic analysis, incident triage, log review, and evidence collection when required.
* Contribute to emerging AI security initiatives, including understanding risks around AI agents, connectors, cloud\-hosted AI workloads, data exposure, and infrastructure security.
* Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to track remediation progress, exceptions, risk acceptance, and closure.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 5–6 years of experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, cloud security, infrastructure security, or related domains.
* Good understanding of cloud security concepts across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Hands\-on or working knowledge of CSPM tools such as Orca, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Defender for Cloud, Lacework, or similar.
* Understanding of vulnerability management processes, including detection, prioritization, remediation tracking, SLA monitoring, and reporting.
* Familiarity with vulnerability scanners such as Rapid7, Qualys, Tenable, or similar.
* Good understanding of infrastructure security, including servers, operating systems, patching, network exposure, identity, and access controls.
* Basic understanding of containers and Kubernetes security, including container images, registries, clusters, namespaces, workloads, secrets, and runtime risks.
* Basic understanding of application security and shift\-left practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, CI/CD security, and secure coding concepts.
* Understanding of AI security concepts such as AI agents, connectors, data access, prompt injection, excessive permissions, and secure integration with enterprise tools.
* Ability to analyze security findings and translate them into clear remediation actions.
* Experience working with dashboards, Excel, Power BI, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar reporting and tracking tools.
* Basic scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, KQL, SQL, or APIs.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work with cloud, infrastructure, application, DevOps, and leadership teams.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Exposure to Kubernetes security tools, container scanning, runtime security, or CNAPP platforms.
* Experience with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Jira, Power BI, Snowflake, or similar enterprise reporting platforms.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, NIST, or cloud security frameworks.
* Understanding of forensic basics such as log analysis, endpoint artifacts, timeline review, and incident evidence handling.
* Experience with automation of vulnerability reporting, data cleanup, ticket enrichment, or remediation workflows.
* Exposure to AI security, GenAI governance, MCP/connectors, agentic workflows, or AI infrastructure security.


 Our Interview Practices
   

  

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

 We are looking for an Information Security Engineer to help grow and mature our Security Operations Centre, which runs on EDR, SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, IAM, firewalls, NIDS/NIPS and a range of other security controls. Alongside SOC work, you will play a central role in supporting IMC's regulatory obligations in India, preparing evidence and coordinating the cyber and systems audits that come with operating in this market.
   

  

 We offer an environment that lets you broaden and deepen your information security knowledge, with access to advanced security technology, frequent training and a culture of knowledge sharing. As you gain experience with our existing SOC technology and processes, you will be given considerable freedom to mature the function through your own initiatives.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Analyse security logs, alerts and reported events, and respond to or assist with the remediation of incidents.
* Hunt for potential compromise across the infrastructure using a range of threat intelligence sources.
* Report discovered vulnerabilities to technology owners and recommend remediation steps.
* Support and improve technical security controls.
* Leverage automation and orchestration to remove repetitive manual work.
* Apply AI\-assisted tooling to alert triage, event summarisation and investigation workflows, with a pragmatic view of its limitations.
* Develop reporting that measures the effectiveness of security controls.
* Develop and improve incident response playbooks.
* Support regulatory and assurance audits: prepare evidence, coordinate with auditors and track observations through to closure.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* A self\-starter with a genuine passion for cybersecurity.
* Previous SOC experience, and/or 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in an enterprise IT environment managing endpoints and applications on\-premises or in the cloud.
* Exposure to security controls such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, and endpoint detection and response.
* Working knowledge of — or a strong willingness to learn — the Indian regulatory cybersecurity landscape: SEBI CSCRF, exchange circulars (NSE/BSE/MCX) and CERT\-In directions, along with familiarity with ISO 27001 and the NIST CSF on which CSCRF is modelled.
* Experience supporting audits (cyber audit, systems audit, VAPT, ISO or SOC 2 assessments) — evidence preparation, auditor coordination and observation remediation — is a strong plus.
* Automation using basic coding skills or low\-code / no\-code tools.
* Awareness of AI and machine learning applications in security operations is a plus; hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted security tooling or LLM\-based workflows is highly regarded.
* Understanding of common attack techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into audit\-ready evidence and regulator\-facing reports.
* Relevant tertiary and/or security qualifications are a plus — for example a Bachelor's degree in information systems or computer science, CompTIA Security\+, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), CEH, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer. If you don't have them yet, you will be supported to pursue certifications on the job.


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: CCTV Operator
description:
**CCTV OPERATOR – JOB ROLE \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Position Purpose** 




 The CCTV Operator shall be responsible for the continuous monitoring, operation, review, maintenance, documentation, and secure management of the organization’s CCTV surveillance system. The Operator shall assist management and authorized security personnel in preventing, detecting, documenting, and responding to security incidents while maintaining strict confidentiality and compliance with applicable laws and organizational policies.
 



  





**Key Duties \& Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Continuous CCTV Monitoring
 



   Monitor all assigned CCTV cameras and surveillance screens continuously during duty hours and promptly identify suspicious, unusual, unsafe, or unauthorized activities.
 



  





 2\. Camera \& Area Coverage
 



   Ensure that critical areas, including entrances, exits, parking areas, reception, corridors, common areas, restricted areas, stores, cash\-handling areas, and other designated locations, remain under appropriate surveillance.
 



  





 3\. Review of CCTV Footage
 



   Search, review, and analyze live and recorded footage whenever required for security incidents, complaints, investigations, accidents, theft, disputes, missing property, unauthorized access, or other legitimate purposes.
 



  





 4\. Incident Identification \& Immediate Reporting
 



   Immediately report suspicious activity, theft, unauthorized entry, violence, accident, fire, damage, safety hazards, tampering, or any other unusual occurrence to the concerned supervisor/manager/security personnel.
 



  





 5\. Emergency Response Coordination
 



   During emergencies, immediately alert the appropriate security, management, fire\-safety, medical, or other authorized personnel and provide relevant CCTV information to assist in the response.
 



  





 6\. Incident Documentation
 



   Record the date, time, location, nature of the incident, camera number, persons involved/observed, action taken, and person to whom the matter was reported.
 



  





 7\. Preparation of Reports
 



   Prepare accurate daily surveillance reports, incident reports, observation reports, footage review reports, equipment fault reports, and other CCTV\-related documentation as required.
 



  





 8\. CCTV Footage Management
 



   Ensure that recordings are properly stored, protected, retained, backed up where applicable, and preserved in accordance with organizational policies and applicable law.
 



  





 9\. Evidence Preservation
 



   When footage may be relevant to an investigation, complaint, dispute, accident, or legal proceeding, ensure that the relevant footage is promptly preserved and is not deleted, overwritten, altered, edited, or otherwise tampered with.
 



  





 10\. Authorized Export of Footage
 



   Export, copy, download, or provide CCTV footage only upon proper authorization. Maintain a record of the date, time, camera, footage period, reason for export, recipient, and authorization.
 



  





 11\. Chain of Custody / Evidence Log
 



   Maintain an appropriate CCTV evidence/footage register for material supplied for investigation, management review, insurance purposes, police authorities, courts, or other authorized purposes.
 



  





 12\. Confidentiality
 



   Maintain strict confidentiality regarding CCTV footage, surveillance information, passwords, system credentials, incidents, employees, guests, visitors, and other sensitive information.
 



  





 13\. Prohibition on Unauthorized Disclosure
 



   CCTV footage, screenshots, photographs, recordings, or surveillance information shall not be shared through WhatsApp, social media, personal email, personal devices, or with unauthorized persons.
 



  





 14\. No Personal Use of CCTV
 



   CCTV systems and footage shall never be used for personal, entertainment, harassment, voyeuristic, discriminatory, retaliatory, or any other unauthorized purpose.
 



  





 15\. Access Control
 



   Maintain strict control over CCTV room access. Only authorized personnel shall be permitted to enter the CCTV/control room or access surveillance systems.
 



  





 16\. Visitor/Technician Access
 



   Any technician, vendor, contractor, police officer, investigator, or other third party requiring access to the CCTV system shall be permitted access only after appropriate authorization and, where required, recorded in the access register.
 



  





 17\. Password \& Credential Security
 



   Protect all CCTV usernames, passwords, PINs, administrator credentials, and system access information. Credentials shall not be disclosed or shared without authorization.
 



  





 18\. System Checking
 



   Regularly check cameras, monitors, DVR/NVR systems, storage devices, network connectivity, power supply, UPS, recording status, date/time settings, and other surveillance equipment.
 



  





 19\. Camera Fault Reporting
 



   Immediately report any camera failure, blind spot, poor image quality, recording failure, storage problem, connectivity issue, power interruption, tampering, or technical malfunction.
 



  





 20\. Daily Equipment Verification
 



   Conduct and document routine checks to ensure that all designated cameras are operational and recording properly.
 



  





 21\. Tampering \& Sabotage Detection
 



   Immediately report any attempt to disconnect, obstruct, reposition, damage, disable, manipulate, or otherwise interfere with CCTV equipment.
 



  





 22\. Time \& Date Accuracy
 



   Regularly verify that CCTV system date and time settings are accurate, as incorrect timestamps may affect incident investigation and evidentiary value.
 



  





 23\. Log \& Register Maintenance
 



   Maintain CCTV monitoring logs, incident registers, footage review records, equipment fault logs, export registers, access registers, and handover records accurately and on time.
 



  





 24\. Shift Handover
 



   Provide a proper written and verbal handover to the incoming CCTV Operator, including pending incidents, equipment faults, requested footage, security alerts, and other important matters.
 



  





 25\. Monitoring of Restricted Areas
 



   Pay particular attention to restricted, sensitive, high\-risk, or unauthorized\-access areas identified by management.
 



  





 26\. Coordination with Security Team
 



   Coordinate with security guards, supervisors, management, reception, maintenance, fire\-safety personnel, and other authorized departments whenever CCTV information is required.
 



  





 27\. Lost \& Found / Property Incidents
 



   Assist in reviewing footage relating to lost property, theft, missing items, damage to property, guest complaints, or other authorized investigations.
 



  





 28\. Employee \& Visitor Incidents
 



   Monitor and review incidents involving employees, guests, visitors, vendors, contractors, or other persons strictly for legitimate security, safety, investigation, or organizational purposes.
 



  





 29\. Privacy \& Data Protection
 



   Handle surveillance information responsibly and comply with applicable privacy, data protection, confidentiality, security, and surveillance\-related laws and organizational policies.
 



  





 30\. Cooperation with Authorized Authorities
 



   Provide assistance and relevant footage to police, courts, government authorities, insurers, investigators, or other authorized bodies only after following the organization’s authorization procedure.
 



  





 31\. Audit \& Compliance Support
 



   Cooperate with internal audits, security inspections, compliance reviews, investigations, and management checks concerning the CCTV system.
 



  





 32\. Incident Escalation
 



   Matters involving serious security threats, criminal activity, violence, fire, life\-threatening emergencies, major property damage, or suspected unauthorized access shall be escalated immediately without waiting for the end of the shift.
 



  





 33\. Professional Conduct
 



   Perform all duties honestly, impartially, responsibly, professionally, and without misuse of surveillance information or system access.
 



  





 34\. Attendance \& Duty Discipline
 



   Remain present and attentive throughout assigned CCTV duty hours and shall not abandon the CCTV monitoring station without proper authorization or arranging an approved handover.
 



  





 35\. Mobile Phone \& Distraction Policy
 



   Personal mobile phone use, entertainment, sleeping, gaming, unauthorized visitors, or other activities that interfere with CCTV monitoring duties shall not be permitted during active surveillance duty.
 



  





 36\. Reporting of Misconduct
 



   Immediately report suspected misuse of CCTV access, unauthorized footage copying, credential sharing, tampering, attempted deletion, unauthorized disclosure, or other violations to the appropriate authority.
 



  





 37\. Compliance with Management Instructions
 



   Follow all lawful and reasonable instructions, SOPs, security protocols, emergency procedures, and confidentiality requirements issued by authorized management.
 



  





 38\. Protection of Organizational Interests
 



   Maintain vigilance and perform surveillance duties in a manner that protects the safety, security, property, reputation, employees, guests, visitors, and other legitimate interests of the organization.
 



  





 39\. Training \& Skill Development
 



   Participate in CCTV, security, emergency\-response, privacy, data\-handling, fire\-safety, and other relevant training programs as directed by management.
 



  





 40\. Other Assigned Duties
 



   Perform other CCTV, surveillance, security\-monitoring, documentation, or related duties reasonably assigned by the authorized supervisor/management, provided such duties are lawful and within the employee’s role.
 



  





**Important Accountability Clause** 




  




* The CCTV Operator shall be individually responsible for maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and security of CCTV systems and surveillance information entrusted to them. Any unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, photographing, recording, alteration, deletion, misuse, manipulation, or sharing of CCTV footage or system credentials shall be treated as a serious breach of duty and may result in disciplinary action and/or other action as permissible under applicable law and organizational policy.

title: Lead OT Cybersecurity Solutions Architect
description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full\-service integrated technology
   

  

 consultancy and professional services to the built environment.
   

  





  

  

 We partner with some of the largest organisations globally, supporting our clients to improve asset performance and security, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 As Lead OT Cybersecurity Solutions Architect, you are FPC Digital’s global technical authority, blending strategy with hands\-on delivery in a high\-profile hybrid role, reporting into the Managing Director with a dotted line into the CTO (Matrix Structure)..
   

  





 In an era where intelligent buildings and data centres lack traditional "air\-gaps," you will design resilient, secure\-by\-design architectures. Your mission includes defining next\-gen OT security services and executing the strategy for our Centre of Excellence (CoE) based OT SOC.
   

  





 Operating across consulting and delivery, you will embed cybersecurity into foundational BMS and Smart Building processes from design through operations.
   

  





 Integrated into the global Technology \& Innovation function, you will lead the Cybersecurity SteerCo within the Technical Design Authority (TDA). Reporting technically to the CTO, you ensure field insights directly shape global standards, partner strategies, and innovation.
   

  





 Though technically focused with no direct reports, you are central to FPC’s people strategy, mentoring a specialised OT Cybersecurity team. You will also enhance auditing benchmarks and provide technical governance across all global deliverables.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 The responsibilities for the Lead OT Cybersecurity Solutions Architect include, but are not limited to, the following key areas:
   

  





  

  





 Technical Design, Smart Building Integration \& Delivery
   

  





  

  





 Secure\-by\-Design Architectures: Define, design and execute end\-to\-end technical security architectures for complex OT, BMS (Building Management Systems), and IoT ecosystems across global Corporate Real Estate and Hyperscale Data Centres.
   

  




* BMS \& Smart Building Design Lens: Embed a robust cybersecurity perspective into the physical and logical design of Building Management Systems and Smart Building infrastructure, championing security as a primary design criterion.
* Cross\-Functional Synergy: Collaborate across all consulting and delivery facets of FPC Digital, aligning strategic advice with practical field engineering and commissioning.
* Standards Enforcement: Champion the application of global security standards, such as IEC 62443, NIST SP 800\-82, and CIS Controls, translating theoretical compliance into practical, robust engineering implementations.
* Zero Trust \& Segmentation: Design and deploy modern network micro\-segmentation, identity and access management (IAM), and zero\-trust policies tailored specifically for fragile, legacy, and modern OT systems.



  

  





 Technical Design Authority (TDA) \& Innovation Leadership
   

  




* Vertical Ownership: Lead the dedicated Cybersecurity SteerCo within FPC’s Technical Design Authority (TDA), serving as the principal expert voice and collaborating directly with the CTO's office on cybersecurity aspects in respect of global technical direction. Attend other TDA SteerCos to provide subject matter expertise on Cybersecurity aspects (namely, Innovation, IT and Technical Architecture SteerCos).
* Cybersecurity SteerCo Chair: Chair and lead the Cybersecurity SteerCo, coordinating with Subject Matter Experts across multiple engineering, software, and operational facets to lead on cybersecurity matters, coordinating with other SteerCos and for cross\-disciplinary support and innovation.
* Lab Environment \- Agnostic Sandbox Curation: Empowered with the technical freedom to curate, test, and evaluate emerging next\-generation security tools within FPC’s Digital Lab environment. This ensures FPC maintains its strict technology\-agnostic position, allowing you to design robust integration playbooks that combine the best tools on the market for our clients' benefit.
* Expert\-Driven Business Value: Ensure that our hands\-on subject matter experts are the primary catalysts driving our business innovation, translating deep domain expertise into scalable, commercial offerings that benefit our global clients and FPC's business growth.



  

  





 Auditing, Benchmarking \& Technical Governance
   

  




* Leveling Up the Auditing Standard: Build upon FPC's highly successful track record of over 500 completed building audits to elevate our existing methodologies into a specialized, next\-generation OT cybersecurity evaluation standard.
* Lighthouse Audits \& Framework Verification: Personally lead high\-complexity "Lighthouse" audits at flagship client sites to establish and validate FPC’s newly elevated OT security frameworks, turning complex technical findings into strategic portfolio risk narratives.
* Auditing Enablement \& Handover: Establish repeatable frameworks and playbook\-driven auditing packages, allowing you to hand over subsequent delivery phases to a trained, competent engineering team.
* Ongoing Governance \& Oversight: Provide technical governance and rigorous quality oversight of all OT cybersecurity deliverables produced by the delivery teams globally, ensuring consistency and alignment with our established benchmarks.



  

  





 Service Definition, Frameworks \& OT SOC Playbook Development
   

  




* Standardised Frameworks \& Policies: Lead the development and engineering of comprehensive OT cybersecurity frameworks, operational policies, and threat mitigation guidelines. These will be deployed directly across our clients' global portfolios, as well as serving as the standardized foundation for FPC's internal service delivery models.
* OT SOC Integration \& Playbook Design: Own the technical design, setup parameters, and operational playbooks for FPC's pioneering OT Security Operations Centre (OT SOC) based out of our Centre of Excellence (CoE). Develop specific threat detection use cases, alerting rules, and incident response playbooks for BMS/EPMS protocols (such as BACnet, Modbus, and LonWorks).
* Collaborative Scaling \& Delivery: Partner directly with FPC’s Global Head of Engineering and Global Head of Operations to co\-author, test, and implement operational workflows. Ensure the OT SOC and broader OT security services are designed for rapid scalability and maximum operational efficiency.
* SLA Alignment: Architect the technical components of the services to cleanly support the delivery of enterprise\-grade Service Level Agreements (SLAs), partnering with FPC Operations who will own day\-to\-day service execution and operational metrics.
* Service Lifecycle \& Portfolio Evolution: Create, define, and launch standardized global OT Cybersecurity service offerings (e.g., threat hunting, managed detection, and secure remote access), collaborating with the Managing Director of FPC Digital and the CTO to keep FPC's commercial strategy ahead of market demands.



  

  





 Thought Leadership, Market Education \& Partner Ecosystem
   

  




* Thought Leadership \& Client Engagement: Act as FPC's foremost industry\-facing expert in the Cybersecurity domain, driving market education and thought leadership by authoring strategic insights, participating in industry event panels, and hosting exclusive, closed\-door forums for major enterprise clients to foster safe knowledge\-sharing and strategic alignment.
* Strategic Partner Ecosystem \& Co\-Innovation: Lead the identification, evaluation, and selection of next\-generation cybersecurity partners. Determine how diverse, best\-in\-class technologies (including edge connectivity, endpoint protection, and identity management platforms) work together to deliver cohesive, robust, and technology\-agnostic enterprise solutions for our global clients, while collaborating with partner engineering teams to influence their roadmaps.
* Technical Mentorship: Act as the internal technical guide for our wider digital engineering division, mentoring junior and mid\-level engineers to create a robust, technically elite OT Cybersecurity team.
* Ongoing Education: Champion continuous learning, certifying that our engineering teams stay ahead of the curve in certifications (e.g., GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443 Specialist).



  

  





 Innovation \& Culture
   

  




* Contribute to improving project delivery processes, tools, and frameworks
* Support lessons learned, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Encourage adoption of best practices and efficient ways of working
* Promote a collaborative and high\-performance team culture



  

  





 FPC Corporate Responsibilities
   

  




* Represent FPC professionally in all client and internal interactions
* Lead and support project teams, fostering collaboration and performance
* Adhere to company policies, governance standards, and reporting requirements
* Support continuous improvement across delivery operations


**Qualifications**

 Skills and Experience
   

  





 Essential:
   

  




* Education: Industry expertise and relevant certifications are highly valued and may substitute for formal academic qualifications.
* High\-level cybersecurity certifications: GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional), GRID (Active Industrial Threat Detection), CISSP, or certified ISA/IEC 62443 cybersecurity specialist.



 Desirable:
   

  




* Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or equivalent professional engineering designation is highly desirable.



 Industry Expertise:
   

  




* A proven track record (typically 10\+ years) in a Principal, Technical Lead, or Design Authority capacity specializing in OT Cybersecurity, Industrial Control Systems (ICS), or Smart Building Systems (BMS/EMS).
* Sector Expertise: Direct experience engineering security solutions for high\-performance spaces, specifically Hyperscale/Colocation Data Centres and Large\-Scale Corporate Real Estate portfolios.
* Standards \& Protocols: Extensive knowledge of IEC 62443, Zero Trust models, and traditional OT networking protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, KNX).
* Auditing Capability: Strong background in establishing physical and digital OT site auditing processes, compiling executive\-level and deep\-dive technical reports.



 Soft Skills:
   

  




* Influence Without Authority: The ability to influence executive\-level client stakeholders and internal delivery teams solely through technical credibility and clear strategic communication.
* The "Teacher" Mindset: A passion for coaching, guiding, and demystifying complex technical risks for others, with a desire to grow collective team capability.



 Personal Attributes
   

  




* Highly professional, with unwavering honesty and integrity.
* Exceptional communicator and client\-relationship builder.
* A continuous and agile learner.
* A systems thinker with attention to detail.
* A strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into action.


**Additional Information**

**Why Join Us?**




**At FPC Global, you’ll be part of a community—not just a company. When you join us, you’ll:**



* Work across a broad and impactful remit
* Gain exposure to multiple business functions
* Develop a strong foundation for future growth opportunities
* Be part of a collaborative, people\-first culture where your contribution truly matters
* Work on impactful projects that shape industries and redefine the built environment
* Grow your career through leadership development, cross\-functional collaboration, and exposure to cutting\-edge technologies
* Be supported and included in a culture that values diversity, balance, and teamwork
* Make a real difference, contributing to high\-performance, innovative, and iconic outcomes worldwide



**We offer a competitive salary and a benefits package tailored to your location and role, including:**



* Flexible \& hybrid working
* Private medical insurance
* Competitive salary \& discretionary annual bonus
* Ongoing professional development

description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

****Process Overview****
 The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
   

  

 GIS Identity \& Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
   

  

****Job Description****
 The Data Engineering Services team is seeking a hands\-on IAM Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and data engineering capabilities that strengthen Identity and Access Management controls, governance, and risk reduction across the enterprise.
   

  

 This role will require to transform complex access, entitlement, identity lifecycle, privileged access, and control data into actionable insights. The candidate will design and develop scalable data pipelines, predictive and detective analytics, AI/ML models, dashboards, and self\-service reporting capabilities that help identify control gaps, access anomalies, toxic combinations, certification inefficiencies, and emerging IAM risks. The role requires strong technical depth in analytics, model development, model governance, AI risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to convert data science outcomes into measurable control improvements and executive\-ready risk narratives.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
* Lead advanced analytics and data science initiatives across IAM controls, access governance, entitlement management, privileged access, joiner\-mover\-leaver processes, access certifications, and policy adherence.
* Analyze large, complex, and disparate identity, access, entitlement, control, application, and audit datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps, risk concentrations, and opportunities for automation.
* Design, build, validate, and tune AI/ML models for IAM use cases such as access anomaly detection, entitlement mining, role mining, toxic access identification, certification prioritization, privileged access monitoring, and control effectiveness measurement.
* Develop scalable data pipelines, feature engineering processes, reusable datasets, and analytics frameworks using Python, R, SQL, Splunk, Neo4j, and enterprise\-approved data platforms.
* Design and maintain executive\-ready dashboards, scorecards, and self\-service reporting solutions that convert IAM control data into actionable insights for process owners, risk partners, and senior leadership.
* Embed model governance and AI risk controls into the analytics lifecycle, including documentation, model inventory, validation evidence, explainability, performance monitoring, drift detection, data lineage, reproducibility, and audit traceability.
* Assess and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, privacy exposure, data quality limitations, explainability gaps, inappropriate automation, overfitting, and adversarial or unintended use of model outputs.
* Partner with IAM, GIS, cyber risk, audit, compliance, privacy, technology, and application teams to translate control requirements into measurable analytics solutions and governance outcomes.
* Drive process improvement and automation by identifying manual control activities, inefficient data handoffs, recurring exceptions, and opportunities to strengthen preventative and detective IAM controls.
* Prepare clear documentation, control evidence, methodology summaries, model performance updates, and risk narratives to support governance reviews, audit readiness, and management reporting.


****Requirements****
**Education :** 
 B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
   

  

**Certifications If Any** 
 : NA
   

  

**Experience Range : 6** 
 \+ years
   

  

****Foundational Skills****
* Expertise in advanced data analytics and statistical modeling using Python, R, and SQL
* Proficiency in data visualization and graph analytics using Neo4j, Tableau, or equivalent tools
* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management architecture, technology and standards
* Strong quantitative analysis, data intuition, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
* Proficiency in AI, machine learning, data mining, feature engineering, and statistical analysis
* Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and executive presentation skills
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end model development lifecycle including data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, deployment readiness, monitoring, drift detection, and performance tuning
* Strong knowledge of model governance practices including model documentation, model inventory, model cards, approval workflows, control evidence, audit traceability, and alignment with enterprise risk management expectations
* Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, explainability gaps, privacy exposure, data quality issues, model drift, overfitting, adversarial misuse, and inappropriate automation of access decisions
* Experience applying AI/ML techniques to IAM datasets such as entitlement mining, access anomaly detection, role mining, toxic access identification, privileged access monitoring, joiner\-mover\-leaver patterns, and access certification optimization


****Desired Skills****
* Experience with data storytelling and reporting design that helps stakeholders make actionable control and risk decisions
* Experience building dashboards or graph\-based analysis views using Tableau, Neo4j, or similar platforms
* Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a fast\-paced environment

* Exposure to generative AI, large language models, prompt evaluation, retrieval\-augmented generation concepts, and safe use of AI assistants for control evidence summarization, policy mapping, and IAM insights

title: SLP Specialist INTL, INSLP
description:
**Description**
 INSLP (Security \& Loss Prevention) is hiring an SLP Specialist to support growth of the “SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program” and help preventing losses via identification of abusive entity. The program is aimed at identifying and eliminating Concessions Abuse while preserving customer trust.
   

  

 The primary objective of the SLP Specialist is to provide security services, investigation and asset protection in designated area of responsibility, assist in mitigating product loss, and maintain customer satisfaction in accordance with INSLP guidelines and policies. The role is cross\-functional and requires deep collaboration and influencing ability with stakeholders from business and corporate functions. SLP Specialist's day\-to\-day activities involve planning, organizing, coordinating, implementing and executing process and procedures laid down by the organization and the SLP function.
   

  

 As a part of the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse program, the SLP Specialist is required to deep dive into the Concessions request raised by customer, and conduct end\-to\-end investigation across customer, DA/network and seller to identify the abusive entity. SLP has outlined frameworks for investigation, and the SLP Specialist is bound to adhere to the investigation guidelines. Along with primarily supporting on Concessions investigations, the SLP Specialist will be required to provide on\-ground intel useful in uncovering abuse MOs. In order to ensure network integrity, the SLP Specialist will be required to conduct risk assessment and process audit for the respective sites and work in accordance with the security policies and guidelines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Security Operation
   

  

* Implementation and follow\-up of Loss Prevention Plan in MDR Concessions


 Audits and Compliance
   

  

* Conducting SLP audits and implementing SOPs
* Surprise check and reports at LM (Last Mile) stations
* Keeping the plans and SOPs updated
* Periodical check of documentation
* Adhering to SLAs defined for the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program


 Process Improvement and Loss Prevention
   

  

* Process review, gap analysis and implementation of necessary improvements
* Weekly, monthly and quarterly assessments
* Loss prevention reporting
* Working on feedbacks received from internal and external stakeholders
* Follow up and completion of CAPA
* Recommending loss prevention initiatives based on on\-ground intel


 Loss Prevention Analysis and Investigation
   

  

* Work closely with the SLP and CS teams to analyze the loss trends in MDR Concessions
* Weekly loss trend analysis, identifying defects / abusive entities and working towards loss reduction
* Conduct investigations by working closely with CS and support functions in SLP and Ops
* Meeting the weekly investigation targets and submitting investigation reports
* Sharing RCAs and PTG initiatives on shrink and unmet goals


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in security and loss prevention

In this role, you will assess application\-layer security risks, identify vulnerabilities in product implementations, and lead secure architecture reviews.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep offensive security skills along with familiarity in testing applications running on or integrated with IBM mainframe systems.
   

  

**Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**

* Conduct penetration testing and red teaming exercises targeting mainframe environments and the surrounding application ecosystem.
* Perform code\-assisted and black\-box penetration testing against enterprise applications/systems interacting with RACF, DB2, CICS, MQ, and


 related subsystems.
   

  

* Identify risks in authentication, authorization, data handling, and communications within mainframe\-integrated products.
* Create threat models and guide product teams in mitigating high\-impact vulnerabilities early in the SDLC.
* Drive remediation efforts through hands\-on collaboration and secure design guidance.
* Author technical reports and deliver executive summaries tailored to various audiences.
* Stay current on vulnerabilities, exploits, and testing techniques relevant to legacy enterprise technologies and mainframe ecosystems.
* Assess common integration patterns (SOA, REST/JSON, MQ) for security risks.


**To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset \& experience:**
* 5\+ years of experience in penetration testing, with a specialization in systems/applications integrating with mainframe environments.
* Deep knowledge of mainframe communication protocols and security mechanisms.
* Demonstrated experience conducting red team\-style assessments or advanced threat emulation on mainframe systems.
* Proficient in tools such as:
* Mainframe utilities: REXX, ISPF panels, NetView
* Security tools: Nmap, Burp Suite, Wireshark, custom scripts
* Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, REXX, Bash, or similar).
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to lead technical teams or projects.
* Experience producing board\-level reports and presenting findings to senior stakeholders.
